card.name: Just before a weekday name in dates
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation right before a weekday name in a date, such as 'on', 'Published:', a dash in a date range, or the start of 'samedi'. It marks the spot where a day of the week is expected next.

modes.label: Posting and publishing lines
modes.description: A word like 'on' or a colon after Posted by, Published or Last modified, just before a date.

modes.label: Event or news dates
modes.description: 'on' or a dash before a weekday in a news item, a date range or a calendar entry.
